rows.name: Tellico
rows.reason: GPL Linux desktop catalogue with local XML and loans, no database server. Preinstall KDE dependencies; borrower sufficiency, no-login startup and historical feature coverage remain unverified.

rows.name: Data Crow
rows.reason: Data Crow provides free open-source local catalogues/categories/loans. Complexity may exceed needs; specific Windows/Linux packages, standalone no-login and pre-cutoff primary version remain unverified despite general cross-platform claims.

rows.name: Apache BookKeeper
rows.reason: It is replicated log and data-storage infrastructure, providing no ready-made book catalogue, borrower management or lending interface for a small physical library.

rows.name: Tellico
rows.reason: Tellico offers Linux local catalogues, fields and loan tracking. Separate user lists and no-login guarantees remain unverified; remote metadata is optional and must be skipped offline.

rows.name: BiblioteQ
rows.reason: Free local library app remains provisional in SQLite mode: SQLite files lack accounts, unlike PostgreSQL logins. No decisive violation established; exact build/catalogue/member workflow unverified.

rows.name: BiblioteQ with SQLite
rows.reason: BiblioteQ with SQLite supports desktop cataloguing and circulation without a database server. Complexity may exceed preferences; no-login behavior remains unverified, and failed schema/source retrieval leaves source verification incomplete.

rows.name: GCstar
rows.reason: GCstar offers open-source collections and lending. Verify book-model/no-login behavior; borrowing example uses movies. Windows/Linux packaging/features postdate cutoff, though a dated pre-cutoff release exists.

rows.name: Apache BookKeeper
rows.reason: Replicated API storage for logs, messages and blobs is an application-building component. The requested catalogue, borrower records and interface require developing a new application.

rows.name: Librarika
rows.reason: Provider-hosted Internet service violates disconnected single-machine operation. Staff/admin authentication also violates no application logins; optional member login does not remove those conflicts.

rows.name: GCstar
rows.reason: Provisional local catalogue/borrower list with Windows/Linux installers. No-login guarantee and exact author/category fields unconfirmed. Install dependencies locally; avoid web lookup/email on the disconnected machine.

rows.name: BookDB2
rows.reason: BookDB2 offers local Windows cataloguing and lending. Freeware, open-source status unestablished; no longer updated. BookDB3 stalled; no-login behavior untested and pre-cutoff availability unverified.

rows.name: BiblioteQ
rows.reason: Local SQLite cataloguing, borrowers and circulation fit an isolated computer; the interface is broader than requested, and exact cutoff-era login behavior remains uncertain.

rows.name: BiblioteQ (SQLite configuration)
rows.reason: BiblioteQ's SQLite mode documents network-less operation and patron records, with greater configuration breadth. Complete no-login and catalogue/user workflows remain unestablished; current/2019 evidence does not prove a 2017 configuration.

rows.name: Librarika
rows.reason: The hosted online service uses accounts and Internet-enabled access, conflicting with the required self-contained computer having no LAN or WAN connection.
